youtube_title: Feel Sick In The Car Or Bus? Stop Doing This | Body Fix #47 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #47. Hill trip, reels on the bus... and suddenly you feel SICK?
B is right. Look at the HORIZON. When your eyes and inner ear agree, you feel better.
Phone says 'still', inner ear says 'moving'. Brain gets confused: nausea.
Fix: Front seat, open window, fresh air, light meal before travel.
Red flags: Vomiting that won't stop, dizzy off the road, headache with vision issues? DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Motion sickness
